(My issues could lie elsewhere) On which system? honestly this may just be more helpful https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-deposit-cli#option-3-build-deposit-cli-with-virtualenv-1 should this work? linux btw debian Yup, it works for me on Linux ok ill go for 3.7 then :P What's your distribution default python version? 2.7 something anyone know how I go about adding the SSL module nvm think I found it https://unix.stackexchange.com/questions/582868/warning-pip-is-configured-with-locations-that-require-tls-ssl-however-the-ssl for those that may have the same noob issues as me :) <@!665270311410728974> good question and the posted link maybe helps... If the problem is the same as in described in the link, you may have to update your certificates packages I may have to yes... lol that's for another day though haha tired now. Hi guys. any batch deposit tools for Medalla? Launch Pad is manual in Metamask, one has to click confirm for every validator. 1000 validators require 1000 click. Hey <@!387720149345763329> there are tools like eth2 that allow you to do so ethdo* https://github.com/wealdtech/ethdo great. thanks. let me check it is unlikely someone will send 1000 real deposits, 10 million dollars worth, using metamask For those types of users, there will likely be different instructions and recommended ways of doing so exactly. Hope so Hi, I'm trying to follow the instructions on the medalla launchpad site ```git clone https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-deposit-cli.git cd eth2.0-deposit-cli ./deposit.sh install ./deposit.sh --num_validators 20 --chain medalla ``` I get an error for ./deposit.sh install ```Collecting lru-dict==1.1.6 (from -r requirements.txt (line 52)) Downloading https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/00/a5/32ed6e10246cd341ca8cc205acea5d208e4053f48a4dced2b1b31d45ba3f/lru-dict-1.1.6.tar.gz Complete output from command python setup.py egg_info: Traceback (most recent call last): File "<string>", line 1, in <module> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'setuptools' ---------------------------------------- Command "python setup.py egg_info" failed with error code 1 in /tmp/pip-build-vn0b3mpm/lru-dict/ Traceback (most recent call last): File "setup.py", line 1, in <module> from setuptools import find_packages, setup ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'setuptools'``` <@!293452142927151106> yep, I stumbled over the same stuff when I tried it. Are you on a 32bit machine? I think I fixed it by manually installing python3-setuptools with apt nope, I'm on 64bit ubuntu server I installed setuptoolz but now getting a new error ```Building wheels for collected packages: lru-dict, pyrsistent, cytoolz, toolz Running setup.py bdist_wheel for lru-dict ... error Complete output from command /usr/bin/python3 -u -c "import setuptools, tokenize;__file__='/tmp/pip-build-dv1j23e0/lru-dict/setup.py';f=getattr(tokenize, 'open', open)(__file__);code=f.read().replace('

');f.close();exec(compile(code, __file__, 'exec'))" bdist_wheel -d /tmp/tmppem5am8qpip-wheel- --python-tag cp36: usage: -c [global_opts] cmd1 [cmd1_opts] [cmd2 [cmd2_opts] ...] or: -c --help [cmd1 cmd2 ...] or: -c --help-commands or: -c cmd --help error: invalid command 'bdist_wheel' ``` seems I have to fix my python first ok afer installing also wheel it worked <https://medalla.beaconcha.in/> & <https://beaconcha.in/> now support medalla Hmm, who sent the 32 mainnet ETH to the medalla deposit contract address? And somebody created a contract at this address on mainnet, seems to be the same creator as on Görli... Ah, looks like there is a safety-net contract deployed on mainnet Afri deployed a recovery contract Noticed that today. Think hes offline for the day but we'll investigate tomorrow If thats anyone in here, DM me! The mainnet 32eth sender has gotten in-touch with us, Afri is aware of this as well
